# Comfort color dark

Comfort color dark is a dark palette with muted accents and readable contrast intended for long writing sessions. It uses Avenir for typography and states compatibility with Obsidian v0.5.0.

![Comfort color dark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obsidian-ezs/obsidian-comfort-color-dark/HEAD/screencap.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Comfort color dark"
    author: "obsidian-ezs"

    slug:   "comfort-color-dark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/comfort-color-dark"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obsidian-ezs/obsidian-comfort-color-dark/HEAD/screencap.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a comfortable dark color palette with muted accents and readable contrast for long writing sessions. Use Avenir for clean, modern typography and enjoy compatibility with Obsidian v0.5.0."
}
```
